sources.title: How Much Does LASIK Cost?
sources.note: states prices starting between $2,495 and $2,895 per eye 'before any discounts or promotions', covering the all-laser procedure, pre-operative exams and follow-up care, and cites a Market Scope survey range of $1,500 to $5,000 per eye across the United States
